entityDescription:
The company aims at using Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) data for high-precision positioning with mobile devices (smartphones).
The main background of the company lies in satellite geodesy, and its applications. Our Special emphasis is on real-time correction models/methods for satellite data, namely atmospheric corrections.
The company was established as a spin-off entity from German Research Center for Geosciences (GFZ) in Potsdam, therefore the scientific support from GFZ is guaranteed. E.g. the company has access to high accuracy real-time satellite clock and orbit corrections developed at Dept. 1 "Geodesy" of GFZ.
Applying these corrections to smartphone location data, a few meter accuracy for positioning of these devices can be achieved.
By using improved positioning accuracy, numerous applications can be supported, such as augmented reality, location-based services, mobile health applications, monitoring systems, and smart social-distancing, which is a key for avoiding the novel COVID-19 pandemic.

entityName: INSTITUT DE RECHERCHES EN INGENIERI - IREIS
entityDescription:
IREIS is the research and development entity of the HEF group based in France. HEF core activity is the surface engineering of materials including, thin film deposition using plasma vacuum process, varnish, paints, nitriding process in molten salts, electrochemical and electroless deposition, projection using plasma torch and laser patterning. The strength of HEF is based on the numerous processes and their combinations, as well as its presence in more than 21 countries. HEF group employ almost 2000 people. 
IREIS develop thin film deposition process for 30 years. The activity was originaly dedicated to the development of materials to reduce friction like diamond like carbon (DLC). IREIS develop their own plasma sources (magnetron sputtering cathodes, Microwave ECR, cathodic arc,…) and implement them in their equipment dedicated to on demand or mass production. IREIS is then in very good position to develop new processes using its knowledge in plasma reactors.
IREIS is a private laboratory and propose research contract services. To support this activity, a strong characterization platform is dedicated to surface analysis including Secondary Electronic Microscope (SEM) with EDX, Spectro-photometer with integration sphere, AFM (Atomic Force Microscope), profilometer, metallographic analysis, X fluorescence, roughness, hardness, scratch test surface tension,…
IREIS optical coating developments last now for almost 20 years with for examples the protected aluminum coating or 143 mirrors for ESA (ESTEC), the gold coating of sun shield of ISO satellite, the development of flexible electrochromic devices with CEA (SYELSO Project), silver coating for Laser Megajoule. More recently IREIS has developed selective coating for solar thermal applications on tubes 2.6 meter long. In that field, a national project objective is to conjugate thin films and diffraction gratings in order to demonstrate the interest to enhance yield of heat harnessing. Other projects include VO2 development at low temperature, research on photochromic materials using silver nanoparticles imbedded in TiO2 matrix.
All development made at IREIS in the field of thin film deposition are done using industrial size pilot machines, able to demonstrate the large scale feasibility and the production of first production lots.

entityDescription: Climateflux is a company that provides microclimatic modeling support by combining high-resolution simulation tools and monitoring techniques for the physical urban climate and physiological responses of pedestrians. The company has been actively developing software applications capable of assessing the transient behavior of outdoor spaces and microclimatic effects involving building facades, vegetation, and climatic factors. As this approach has been limited by the resolution and quality of available data, Climateflux benefits from its expertise in data-integrated models and combining the simulation approach with environmental sensing techniques to make the connection between the human factor and the built environment.

entityDescription:
As a leading bio-tech company, we here at Algatek are revolutionising the way in which industries function. Following 7 years of research, we developed and patented a bioreactor known as the Algatek Algae Accelerator (AAA). The purpose is to grow large batches of algae in a swift manner without compromising on quality.

As a company, we are working towards our main goal of creating a future that enhances the health of feed to Humans whilst delivering oxygen, and sequestrating CO2 which protects the environment. There are three main objectives that we want to achieve:

A Better Future
Sustainable Processes
Cleaner Food and Environment
Algae is a ‘super product’ that is renewable and available in abundance. We are already revolutionising the food market, but this substance also has the potential now to support life in severe conditions.
Our method allows us to create a formula that both nourishes the body and keeps the environment protected to sustain Human life.

Our proprietary AAA bioreactor technology enables us to produce large high-quality microalgae. Unlike other methods, our AAA bioreactor technology allows us to cultivate the algae 24/7.

Industrial production of microalgae biomass is even with the latest known production technology suffering from a combination of high production costs, low yields due to reliance on climate and sunshine hours per day and fluctuating qualities. This is caused by lack of control of the critical growth parameters, such as applied levels of carbon dioxide and other nutrients, the water temperature and PH values as well as the correct light spectrums.

Here at Algatek in our "state of the art facility" we believe we can create the dream of sustained Life Support not only for human nutrition, but for the crops also that feed us.

entityName: OKTAL SYNTHETIC ENVIRONMENT SAS - OKTAL SE
entityDescription:
OKTAL Synthetic Environment (OKTAL-SE) was created in 2001 by its Chief Executive Officer Mr. Jean LATGER as an emanation of the OKTAL company created in 1989. Today, OKTAL-SE is part of the SOGECLAIR Group located in Toulouse-France. Our company is a human-sized structure that ensures a high reactivity and a customer focused attitude.

Our purpose is to provide customers with state of the art multi-sensor simulation software and services. Thanks to the reliability and the performance of our modeling and simulation COTS products, OKTAL-SE has become an international reference in terms of synthetic environment rendering software in both Electro-Optic (Visible, Infrared) and Radio-Frequency (Radar, GNSS) domains.

In more than 15 countries, our customers trust the OKTAL-SE simulation software as the reference and the cost effective solution to design, develop and qualify any embedded sensor system.

Since its creation, OKTAL-SE has built long term relationships with National defense agencies and key players in the aerospace and defense market. In the Electro-Optics and Radio-Frequency domains, the OKTAL-SE engineering tools have proved their validity and their efficiency on major industrial programs (SCALP, AASM…) and we are still supporting our customers all along their projects by providing them with the best of our technology and experience.

Our commitment: getting the most out of sensor simulation for your final application.

entityName: DLR - INSTITUTE OF NETWORKED ENGERY SYSTEMS (DLR VE)
entityDescription:
The Oldenburg DLR Institute of Networked Energy Systems develops technologies and concepts for the future energy supply on the basis of renewable energies. The focus is on the challenge of turning weather-dependent decentralised generation into stable and efficient energy systems. This transformation process is being researched within the framework of a consistent D3 approach (D3 = decarbonisation, decentralisation, digitisation). With its departments of Urban and Building Technologies, Energy System Technology and Energy System Analysis, the Institute is dedicated to system-oriented questions on the intelligent and efficient linking of the electricity, heat and transport sectors. System levels ranging from individual systems to 'smart' buildings to networked residential neighbourhoods and cities are considered. In addition, the Institute evaluates energy systems on a national and international level using its own network structure models and technology assessment methods.

Research Topics:
- Technologies for decentralised power and heat generation
- Technologies for sector integration in buildings, mobility and gas technology
- Power grid technology and management
- Systems integration and energy management in the smart home, smart city and smart grid
- Systems integration of various storage technologies and other flexibility options, future provision of ancillary services
- Modelling of power grids and energy systems
- Technology assessment
- Energy meteorology

NematX Ltd. is a spin-off company from ETH Zurich, incorporated in 2020 and currently supported by the ESA BIC Switzerland program. We develop new materials & manufacturing processes to solve tomorrow's technical & societal challenges - from deep sea to outer space. As the pioneering company to make liquid crystal polymers (LCPs) available for additive manufacturing/3D printing, we can offer materials and a manufacturing platform to produce the highest performing parts from polymer 3D printing. Our parts are 10x stronger than PEEK, they show >250°C heat resistance plus they show superior inertness in chemical & biological environments.

With respect to space compliance testing, ESTEC has recently performed material characterization experiments within the framework of our participation in ESA's Euro Material Ageing and ATOX campaigns. Our 3D printed LCP parts showed minimal outgassing (0.05% total mass loss) and low erosion yields (2.18 E-24 cm3/atom).

entityDescription:
Jagiellonian University is one of the best and the most prestigious Polish universities. Founded in 1364 it is also the oldest university in Poland, the second university in Central Europe (after university in Prague founded in 1348) and one of the oldest universities in Europe. Initially it consisted of three faculties only, i.e. liberal arts, medicine and law. In 1400 faculty of theology was added, which was regarded at that time in Europe as the highest rank discipline.
University was at the height of its flowering in fifteenth and sixteenth century. In the years 1491-95 Nicolas Copernicus was one of the university students. In the years 1433-1510 the number of foreign students studying in the university reached 44% of all scholars. This fact shows its high international position at that time. 
Nowadays Jagiellonian University educates over 50 000 students on the three levels: bachelor, master and doctoral degree according to Bolonia Process rules. Students can enter 58 different disciplines and 129 specializations with Polish as language of instruction and several specializations lectured in English. About 5% of students are foreigners. Currently, the new campus for physical and natural sciences is under construction. Nearby the Technology Park and the new high-tech (biomedical and informatics) small industry plants are growing. The new facilities are very well equipped with modern advanced scientific instruments. The University is a good European teaching and research institution. It is usually ranked at the first or second place in Poland by the external evaluating agencies, when the quality of education and research are taken into consideration. It was also granted the accreditation from the Department Education of USA for their degree programs for foreign students in English.

We are an independent foundation and one of the world’s foremost research communities on energy, located in Halden and Kjeller. We have developed unique skills over 70 years of world-leading researchers and outstanding international projects in our reactors and laboratories.
Our research reactors have led to better nuclear safety in our neighboring countries and around the world, and are also key in leading research on energy and materials in Norway. At IFE we look into materials in new ways. We develop and produce cancer medicine. We are far ahead in the pursuit of next-generation battery technology and contribute to better solar, wind and hydrogen solutions. Offshore, we have developed low-emission petroleum technology and advanced digital solutions for management, security and communication.
The knowledge, innovation and development at IFE has created hundreds of billion NOK in values ​​for Norway and improved safety, environment and climate both at home and abroad.
When the next chapter in Norway’s story is to be written, it will be about how we convert. It has always been the great strength of IFE.We will continue to bridge the gap between research, education and industrial enterprises.We will continue to research – for a sustainable future.

TECNALIA (www.tecnalia.com) is a Spanish private, non-profit, research organization.
Its main areas of action are Advanced Manufacturing, Digital Transformation, Energy Transition, Sustainable Mobility, Health and Urban Ecosystem. TECNALIA currently has a team of more than 1,472 experts and an income of 115 Million € in 2020. 
The activities of TECNALIA for Space are integrated in the Industry and Transport Unit. The company has been providing technology in materials, telecommunications and manufacturing process to the major Spanish Space subsystems providers and ESA. Between these sectorial units, TECNALIA Aerospace unit has a large reputation on space technology. Space specialization is focused in advanced materials and processes for launchers and spacecrafts. This experience has been gained through large number of R&D contracts with ESA and the development of flight hardware. Some of the missions and instruments or subsystems with TECNALIA-Aerospace participation are in ISS instruments (TRIBOLAB; BIOLAB, COSMIC), Science (XMM, INTEGRAL), launchers (VULCAN, EXPERT), Earth observation (ARTEMIS), Telecom (Electric propulsion thrusters ROS99, ROS00, DSHET), GAIA, and a large number of technological activities.
